en: Dependent on a state that is neither a root-cause nor rootless, there arises a state that is neither a root-cause nor rootless by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither a root-cause nor rootless, there arises a state that is rootless but not a root-cause by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither a root-cause nor rootless, there arises a state that is neither a root-cause nor rootless... [and so forth].
States that are neither rootless nor non-roots arise with the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is both neither rootless nor non-root, a state that is both neither rootless nor non-root arises with the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is both neither rootless nor non-root, a state that is both a root and neither rootless arises...

A state arises by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is neither rootless nor non-root, there arise states that are both non-root and not rootless, and states that are both not rootless and non-root, by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state that is both non-root and not rootless, and a state that is both not rootless and non-root, there arises a state that is both non-root and not rootless, by way of root condition… three. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to cause, nine; with respect to object, nine …pe… with respect to non-disappearance, nine.
(The same detailed expansion applies everywhere in the section on co-nascence …pe… and in the section on inquiry.)
